title: Avrocar as cover for Roswell craft work and Nazi scientist recruitment
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Avrocar as cover for Roswell craft work and Nazi scientist recruitment, about 1947-1960s at Wright Field; Canada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, suggests that the Avrocar, a saucer-shaped experimental aircraft built in Canada, was probably a cover for something deeper. He points to rumors that a craft said to have crashed near Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947 was taken to Wright Field, a US military airfield, and links the work to names such as John Frost, Richard Miethe, Viktor Schauberger and Henri Coanda. If true, it would mean the public saucer project hid secret study of a recovered craft and the recruitment of former Nazi scientists.
